text:
maria: I created RC 1.12.0-rc1 for the serving runtime + model swap. Pinning runtime=2.7, model=model-v2.3.1-8bit. Change window 2025-03-28 02:00-03:30 UTC. Requesting sign-offs and rollout plan.
ajay: quick q — any regressions in staging perf?
maria: staging smoke passed. p95 +12ms, median unaffected. unit & integration tests green. Key changes: KV cache eviction fix, batcher timeout tweak, quantization flag adjustments. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/1.12.0-rc1
leo: we'll need to pin the model artifact tag too, not just runtime image. confirm model tag is model-v2.3.1-8bit
maria: confirmed.
deploy-bot: Created release 1.12.0-rc1 (by maria). Artifacts: registry.redwood/serving:1.12.0-rc1, model=registry.redwood/models:model-v2.3.1-8bit. Release notes uploaded. Rollout policy currently: canary steps defined but pending sign-off.
olivia: +1 on pin. Suggest explicit auto-rollback criteria: if 5m error rate > 3% OR p95 latency increases > 30% over baseline => auto-rollback to previous revision. Also require manual override to bypass.
ajay: agree. Canary steps should be 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m steady-state at each step and health checks passing.
maria: I updated the release config. Snippet:

```yaml
rollout:
  steps: [10, 30, 60, 100]
  steady_state: 600s
  rollback_if:
    error_rate_5m_pct: 3
    p95_increase_pct: 30
```
deploy-bot: Starting canary: step 1 (10% traffic) at ts=1752104410.
sre-bot: Alerting hooks enabled for this rollout. Pages will go to #oncall-sre if thresholds exceeded.
leo: observing a small spike in 502s at one region (iad). Investigating logs.
maria: hold promotion. Do not advance to 30% until we understand root cause.
leo: root cause looks like KV cache evictions when sequence length > 2048 for a subset of requests. Repro in staging with a crafted prompt. Hotfix branch created: fix/kv-evict-guard.
maria: decision: if fix can be merged and smoke redeploy validated within 15m we'll resume. If not, we abort this RC and roll back to prod version 1.11.4. Marking the release as paused.
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% (action by maria).
olivia: logging note — update release notes with the observed canary spike and pause reason. Also include rollback criteria and contact points.
maria: done. Release notes now include canary findings and mitigation plan. Link: https://confluence.redwood/release/1.12.0-rc1#canary
ajay: once fix is in, re-run full canary starting at 0->10% to be safe. Also add a longer steady-state at 30% (15m) for this RC due to KV edge case.
maria: copy. Sign-offs for initial attempt: ajay, olivia, leo. Holding until fix verification.
leo: will post update in ~8m after CI finishes. tagging @oncall-sre FYI.
maria: thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for promotion decision. Will update with final promote/abort call.
